Job Title: .net/C# Developer
 Duration: 12 months + Possible extension 
 Location- Austin, TX 78758 
 
 Qualification Notes from Hiring Manager: 
 
 Team needs heavy C# development skills, more backend focused as against front end. Looking for S/W Engineers as against Web Development 
 Mongo dB, Sql experience preferred 
 
 Programming code test over phone and in-person 
 
 Communication is very important - must be able to speak and articulate well with geographically disbursed teams 
 Agile experience preferred 
 Process maturity 
 Large environment background preferred as against small org 
 must have developed Complex application 
 Candidates who have had experience coding for complex algorithms \ those involving mathematical calculations will be excellent match 
 Info from Hiring Manager: 
 
 • API development and the ability to optimize C# application code for parallel execution for queued worker processes 
 o Ability to think in terms of large and complex systems and dependencies (e.g. make a change in location X and know what impact it has on several other dependent systems) 
 o Ability to reduce execution times and design code that can be broken into multiple units of execution that can be run in parallel 
 o Expert C# skills and the knowledge to implement domain models and APIs that adhere to SOLID principles 
 o Being able to create and maintain unit testing frameworks (our codebase has a high percentage of code coverage) 
 • REST service development against WebAPI back end 
 o Includes knowledge of security protocols for secure authentication such as SAML, OAUTH, etc. 
 o Understands ODATA formatting of REST queries 
 • Ideally experience with NoSQL (Mongo or equivalent) although SQL Server relational DB experience is helpful here. We use MongoDB 
 Prannoy Datta | Team Recruitment | Mindlance, Inc. | Office: 7326306118 |  


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
